To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a 2.6-GHz band asymmetric Doherty power amplifier using a 320W GaAs HEMT with an inverse Class-F output matching network and a 210W GaN HETM was successfully developed.
a 2.6-GHz-band 537-W peak power GaN-HEMT asymmetric Doherty PA with 48% efficiency at 7-dB ACLR was successfully developed.
a high Psat asymmetric Doherty PA using a single-ended 2.6Ghz GaN HEMt was developed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, fabrication, and testing of a 537W GaN HEPMT Doherty amplifier.
the design and implementation of a high-efficiency asymmetric Doherty power amplifier (PA) for 2.4–2.7GHz applications.
the design, development and measurement of the 537W peak output power asymmetric Doherty amplifiers for 2.4–2.7GHz band.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 2.6 GHz GaN Doherty Amplifier developed by this project is a significant step forward in terms of power efficiency and output power.
the asymmetric Doherty topology is an excellent choice for high efficiency and high power amplifiers.
this work has shown the excellent suitability of GaN HEMTS for high power amplifier design and the possibility of achieving high efficiency and high linearity at 2.6 GHz.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
GaN Doherty amplifiers can provide high output power with high drain efficiency and high linearity.
a GaN HEMTS asymmetric Doherty PA with high Psat and drain efficiency was successfully developed.
the 2.6 GHz band 537 W peak power GaN Doherty amplifier has been successfully developed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a single GaN HEMTdied-based asymmetric Doherty power amplifier can be used to replace two separate GaN HEMTDied-based power amplifiers in a conventional Doherty power amplifiers.
the asymmetric Doherty architecture with the newly developed 320-W GaN HEMTS can be used to develop a 2.6-GHz band 537-W GaN HET amplifier with high Psat and high drain efficiency.
the newly developed 320 W GaN HEMt can achieve high efficiency and high power with a compact size.
